q: On 2026-10-02 we recorded a loss. Quantify exactly how much of the profit deterioration versus 2026-10-01 came from lower revenue, advertising cost, COGS, discounts, refunds, shipping, payment costs, and other available cost components. Reconcile the components back to the total profit change.
answer:
Net profit fell by -₹16,571 from -₹1,137 on 2026-10-01 to -₹17,708 on 2026-10-02 — the full change is reconciled exactly to the P&L lines below (order‑date P&L / event-date lines, per the catalogue).

What changed (ordered by impact on the profit deterioration)
- Lower net sales (P&L basis) — fell from ₹74,595 to ₹31,341 (change −₹43,254) and increased the profit shortfall by −₹43,254. This is the single largest driver of the profit drop.  
- Lower COGS (net COGS) — fell from ₹29,764 to ₹13,544 (change −₹16,220) and therefore reduced the profit shortfall by +₹16,220 (i.e., smaller COGS partially offset the revenue loss). Product cost was the main COGS line: down ₹13,891.  
- Lower ad spend (P&L basis) — fell from ₹45,968 to ₹35,505 (change −₹10,463) and therefore reduced the profit shortfall by +₹10,463 (less ad spend mitigated some of the loss).  
- Changes in returns/cancels and discounts (net sales sub‑lines): returns (return revenue) fell from ₹14,018 to ₹9,360 (change −₹4,658 → effect +₹4,658), cancel revenue fell ₹1,906 (effect +₹1,906), discounts fell ₹951 (effect +₹951). These lower deductions partially offset the revenue fall.  
- Shipping, packaging, payment gateway and RTO costs all fell (shipping −₹1,508 → effect +₹1,508; packaging −₹560 → +₹560; payment gateway fees −₹137 → +₹137; RTO −₹124 → +₹124) and thus partly offset the deterioration.

Reconciliation (signed effects sum to the net profit change)
- Net profit: -₹1,137 → -₹17,708 ; change = -₹16,571.  
- Component effects that sum to -₹16,571 (largest leaves shown): Gross sales −₹50,768; Product cost +₹13,891; Net COGS +₹16,220; Return revenue +₹4,657; Ad spend +₹10,463; Discounts +₹951; Shipping +₹1,508; Packaging +₹560; Payment fees +₹137; RTO +₹124; Cancel revenue +₹1,906. The signed sum equals the total net profit change.

Worth checking: verify the large drop in net sales (₹43,254) by product or channel (Meta vs Google) to see which demand pockets fell most.

Period: 2026-10-01..2026-10-02 · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-14
